name: Los Palacios y Villafranca (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Los Palacios y Villafranca (a bull on yellow, figures and the words LA UNIÓN Y).
history: The flag was approved and published at the same time as the arms; it is rectangular, divided horizontally into three stripes of equal width, red above, blue in the centre and yellow below, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Los Palacios y Villafranca arms — bull on yellow and figures, inscribed LOS PALACIOS, VILLAFRANCA and LA UNIÓN
